description: Net Promoter Score calculator — Net Promoter Score from raw 0-10 survey ratings (scores=10,9,8,...) or counts (promoters=, passives=, detractors=). Returns NPS, promoter/passive/detractor %, grade, standard error, confidence interval (confidence=80|90|95|98|99), responses needed for +/-5 and +/-3 margins, score distribution and what-if conversions. Optional benchmark= (industry NPS) significance check and compare_scores= (a second survey wave) with an unpooled z-test, p-value and verdict. Offline, instant. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: business_nps
